blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A verdict in Vice President Sara Z. Duterte’s impeachment trial could come as early as December if the defense completes its remaining eight to 10 witnesses within the next few weeks, Bicol Saro Party-list Rep. Terry Ridon, a House prosecutor, said in a statement on Tuesday. According to Ridon, the defense could finish presenting its evidence by the end of November or during the first week of December, allowing the Senate impeachment court to proceed with the final stages of the trial.
